import JudgeProblem
-- mathgraph constructor: equality-chain

def submission : Goal := by
  intro G _ h
  intro x y z w
  have p0 : (x ◇ y) = ((w ◇ w) ◇ w) := h (x) (y) (w)
  have p1 : (((z ◇ z) ◇ z) ◇ w) = ((w ◇ w) ◇ w) := h (((z ◇ z) ◇ z)) (w) (w)
  have p2 : ((w ◇ w) ◇ w) = (((z ◇ z) ◇ z) ◇ w) := Eq.symm p1
  have p3 : (x ◇ y) = (((z ◇ z) ◇ z) ◇ w) := Eq.trans p0 p2
  exact p3
